doan_van.noi_dung: Tuan relies on his latest smartphone device for every errand. He believes this innovation brings more efficiency than any traditional method. Tuan leaves home to fetch a parcel but forgets his power bank. The navigation app drains his battery faster than expected due to excessive data usage. He finds his phone obsolete as the screen fades to black. Tuan feels far less capable without his digital assistant. He struggles to navigate the streets because he lacks basic local knowledge. This experience highlights the vast difference between digital literacy and real world problem solving. He finally manages to locate the post office by asking a stranger for directions. The heavy reliance on technology makes his daily tasks much harder when the system fails. He returns home and decides to carry a physical map in the future.

luu_y:
**① whereas / while nối 2 mệnh đề trong CÙNG một câu, có dấu phẩy trước:**
✅ Sales rose in Japan, **whereas** they fell in Korea.
❌ Sales rose in Japan. Whereas they fell in Korea.

**② “compared with” + danh từ, không phải mệnh đề:**
✅ 90%, **compared with** 55% for laptops.
❌ compared with laptops are 55%.

**③ data là số nhiều trong văn học thuật** (số ít: datum), nhưng trong văn viết hiện đại “data is” được chấp nhận rộng rãi. Trong IELTS, cả hai đều không bị trừ điểm.

**④ Cấu trúc “gấp X lần” — sai trật tự là lỗi phổ biến:**
✅ twice **as many** users **as** B · ✅ three times **higher than** B
❌ twice more than B · ❌ three times as higher as B

**⑤ technology không đếm được** khi nói chung: ❌ technologies are changing our life → ✅ **Technology is** changing our lives.

**⑥ respectively** đặt cuối câu, dùng khi liệt kê 2 cặp số liệu song song:
*The figures for A and B were 20% and 35% **respectively**.*
meo:
- **whereas = “trong khi đó”** — luôn nằm **giữa** câu, không bao giờ mở đầu một câu mới.
- Cụm định lượng nhớ 2 mẫu duy nhất: **“X times as ADJ as Y”** và **“X times ADJ-er than Y”**. Không trộn hai mẫu.
- Task 2 mở bài chỉ cần **2 câu**. Viết dài hơn là lãng phí thời gian cho phần không được chấm nhiều.

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Công nghệ và so sánh đối chiếu
mini_story.truyen: Modern innovation focuses heavily on automation and artificial intelligence to improve daily efficiency. Digital literacy is significantly higher among young adults than it is among the elderly population. This gap in skills creates a clear divide when navigating any smart device for basic tasks. My daily routine at home relies on a central hub that manages household data and privacy settings. Each morning, I check my connected kitchen to ensure that previous manual chores are now fully accessible through voice commands. Automation makes life much easier compared to the past when everything required physical intervention. However, the risk of addiction to technology is twice as high as the risk of losing physical connectivity. Cyber security is also far more important today than it was a decade ago. Suddenly, the power grid fails and every modern tool becomes completely obsolete. I must perform all my morning tasks without any digital assistance for the rest of the day.
